purpose: Spawn exactly one stochastic temporary research direction per exact trigger invocation, with ClayCode intentionally dominant.
selection_scope: registered scientific branches only; meta commands and entity-address commands are excluded
dominance_invariant: claycode has strictly greater selection probability than every other individual branch

spawn_semantics.candidate_microdirections: derive 3-7 falsifiable, branch-faithful directions from current OPEN/CURRENT evidence, live work, negative results and current stage
spawn_semantics.microdirection_draw: random among eligible candidates after novelty filtering
spawn_semantics.duplicate_rule: do not reroll the selected branch; reroll only the microdirection up to 3 times if its normalized topic signature duplicates a recent spawn without replication value
spawn_semantics.replication_exception: a repeated direction is allowed when explicitly selected as replication/falsification and the receipt says why

hard_guards: selection probability never constitutes evidence priority or truth authority
random selection never overrides safety, authority, staged-program gates or explicit owner directives
Frank never gains authority to mutate its own Harness
negative results and contradictions remain preserved
a spawned field must not claim independence when it shares evidence/architecture ancestry with its source branch
